name: BeakerWise: The Real Science Lab
summary:
A LAB ON YOUR TABLE
In mixed reality a virtual lab bench sits on your real table. Or work in a virtual science room. Burettes, Bunsen burners, circuits, lenses and microscopes, all virtual. Play seated. Every action also has a button on the panel.

104 EXPERIMENTS
21 in biology, 28 in chemistry, 33 in physics and 22 simpler first experiments. From melting ice and magnets to titrations, flame colours and light through two slits. Many are linked to the practical skills in the Department for Education's GCSE a
